paragraphs.zh: 在-5～5℃将60％氢化钠9.2g溶于80mL无水四氢呋喃中，往该溶液中滴加三氟乙醇24g的20mL无水四氢呋喃溶液，滴加完毕后，进一步滴加式(III)化合物83g的400mL无水四氢呋喃溶液，滴加时控制反应物温度不超过15℃。滴加完毕后，搅拌，通过高效液相色谱监测反应完成后加水淬灭。分液，有机相用40mL饱和食盐水洗涤两次，旋蒸除去溶剂，残余物用120g甲醇或乙醇重结晶，过滤，滤饼于60℃烘干，得到式(IV)化合物。熔点80-82℃。
paragraphs.en: At -5 to 5℃, 9.2 g of 60％ sodium hydride was dissolved in 80 mL of anhydrous tetrahydrofuran; to this solution was added dropwise a solution of 24 g of trifluoroethanol in 20 mL of anhydrous tetrahydrofuran. After the addition was complete, a solution of 83 g of the compound of formula (III) in 400 mL of anhydrous tetrahydrofuran was further added dropwise, the temperature of the reaction mixture being kept below 15℃ during the addition. After the addition was complete, the mixture was stirred, and after the reaction was monitored to completion by high performance liquid chromatography it was quenched by adding water. The layers were separated, the organic phase was washed twice with 40 mL of saturated brine, the solvent was removed by rotary evaporation, and the residue was recrystallised from 120 g of methanol or ethanol, filtered, and the filter cake was dried at 60℃ to give the compound of formula (IV). Melting point 80-82℃.
paragraphs.notes: The 9.2 g refers to 60％ sodium hydride (a dispersion), as printed. The hyphen in "-5～5℃" is a minus sign as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 高效液相色谱条件：Kromasil的C18反相色谱柱，流动相为乙腈:水(加0.1％甲酸)＝60:40(V:V)，流速1.0mL/min，柱温30℃，检测波长210nm，进样体积5μL。
paragraphs.en: High performance liquid chromatography conditions: Kromasil C18 reversed-phase column; mobile phase acetonitrile:water (with 0.1％ formic acid added) ＝ 60:40 (V:V); flow rate 1.0 mL/min; column temperature 30℃; detection wavelength 210 nm; injection volume 5 μL.

paragraphs.zh: 实施例6 式(V)羧酸化合物的制备1
paragraphs.en: Example 6 Preparation 1 of the carboxylic acid compound of formula (V)

paragraphs.zh: 向高压釜中加入式(IV)化合物40g、水20g、三乙胺26.49g、PdCl₂催化剂0.4g、配体1,4-双(二苯基膦)丁烷4.65g、溶剂1,4-二氧六环400g，抽真空，氮气置换，以约1～4MPa的压力通入CO，在80℃反应约12h。通过高效液相色谱监测反应完成后，过滤，旋蒸除去溶剂二氧六环，加入甲醇溶解，调酸至pH为2～3，析出白色固体，过滤，滤饼经水洗、打浆后过滤，得到式(V)化合物，收率81.13％，熔点155-157℃。
paragraphs.en: Into an autoclave were charged 40 g of the compound of formula (IV), 20 g of water, 26.49 g of triethylamine, 0.4 g of PdCl₂ catalyst, 4.65 g of the ligand 1,4-bis(diphenylphosphino)butane and 400 g of the solvent 1,4-dioxane; the vessel was evacuated and purged with nitrogen, CO was introduced at a pressure of about 1 to 4 MPa, and the reaction was carried out at 80℃ for about 12 h. After the reaction was monitored to completion by high performance liquid chromatography, the mixture was filtered, the solvent dioxane was removed by rotary evaporation, methanol was added to dissolve the residue, the acidity was adjusted to pH 2 to 3, a white solid precipitated, it was filtered, and the filter cake was washed with water, slurried and filtered to give the compound of formula (V), yield 81.13％, melting point 155-157℃.
paragraphs.notes: The ligand is printed as 1,4-双(二苯基膦)丁烷 (1,4-bis(diphenylphosphino)butane, dppb).

paragraphs.zh: 高效液相色谱条件：与实施例5相同。
paragraphs.en: High performance liquid chromatography conditions: the same as in Example 5.
